title: Following Oliver and Keppard wagons as a boy
summary: As a boy he ran after wagons carrying Joe Oliver and Freddie Keppard, and moved to the city when grown.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Now, what about... Though, when you were a little boy, do you remember the names of any bands that were good then?

Well, I used to run all around to see Joe Oliver and, uh... Oh, man. Yeah, see Joe Oliver and, uh, Freddie Kepa. They used to pass on a little wagon, you know, there wasn't no trucks. Yeah. Then for the appetizer, they used to have them wagon and horse, and you could keep up with them and furniture wagging. You know, one time they used to have furniture wagging, you know, with the four wheels. Well, that's what they used to get the appetizer in. And you could keep up with them.
Did you get lost doing that?
No, I ain't never get lost, because while they start out from there, they always was going to come back there.
In those days, did you still live across the river? When did you move over here?
Oh, I moved over here then when I got to be a man. But yet I used to run around for to see them bands and keep up with them.
